rule: Shadows by place (C20, owner 2026-11-08): a component reads one of four shadows, --sf-shadow-flat, --sf-shadow-raised, --sf-shadow-overlay or --sf-shadow-modal, and nothing else -- no numbered level (--sf-elevation-N--shadow, --sf-ui-shadow-N), no C16 step name (--sf-shadow-card, -popup, -popup-nested), no colour of its own. A place that floats takes its surface with its shadow: raised on --sf-surface-raised, overlay on --sf-surface-popup (a nested popup on --sf-surface-popup-nested), modal on --sf-surface-popup over the scrim (black 64). In the dark theme the ambient shadow is none and the key one is short, so the surface carries the height.

places.flat: the page, an area, a card at rest: no shadow, the edge is --sf-outline-variant
places.raised: a card under the pointer, a sticky bar while content runs under it, a handle, a plate
places.overlay: a dropdown, a menu, a popover, a tooltip, a toast, a dragged copy
places.modal: a window, a drawer, a sheet: always over the scrim

utility: shadow-flat/-raised/-overlay/-modal and drop-shadow-* draw a place's shadow alone; elevation-N keeps its surface and takes its place's shadow; the numbered classes are former names until 2027-01-01.
